provenance.kind: Canonical real rendered Vancouver default entry road/canopy source fixture
limitations: CPU canonical extraction excludes visual medium landmark meshes and asynchronously loaded street furniture
Saved local fixture keeps actual road vertices, source building volumes/roofs/lamps and tree data; water/terrain context outside extracted sources is not a full-city replay
replayNotes: The compact road meshes preserve source Float32 coordinates but renumber local triangle IDs.
Lamp DEM elevations are sampled with the production CityEngine.rawElevation method and recorded alongside the extracted lamp points; all saved tree bases already have explicit source Y.
